intent: Every risky claim phrase in shipped Buyer-facing copy must appear here with a justification. A new occurrence fails PilotCopyClaimsTest until it is reviewed and recorded, so the claim surface cannot grow silently.

reviewed.justification: Negated savings disclaimer included in the stored core report limitations.

reviewed.contains: This is not legal, mechanical, title, or purchase-safety advice.
reviewed.justification: Negated advice disclaimer included in the synthetic report limitations.
Negated scope disclaimer on every generated explanation; it withdraws a savings claim rather than making one.

reviewed.contains: Negotiation outcomes are uncertain; savings are not guaranteed.
reviewed.justification: Negated uncertainty disclosure attached to the estimated-savings figure, required by DEVELOPMENT_SPEC.md PLAN-05.

reviewed.contains: it does not establish that a document is safe to sign
reviewed.justification: Negated standing disclosure. DEVELOPMENT_SPEC.md section 1.2 forbids the positive claim; stating its absence is the disclosure the pilot requires.

reviewed.contains: does not guarantee savings or any negotiating outcome
reviewed.justification: Negated standing disclosure withdrawing savings and outcome guarantees.

reviewed.contains: or mechanical advice, it does not establish that a document is safe to sign
reviewed.justification: Negated advice-boundary disclosure required by DEVELOPMENT_SPEC.md section 13.

reviewed.contains: otdog never contacts a dealer itself.
reviewed.justification: Negated standing disclosure in the footer. DEVELOPMENT_SPEC.md sections 1.2 and 1.3 forbid the positive claim; the Buyer sends every email from their own email.

reviewed.contains: does not contact dealers for the Buyer.
reviewed.justification: Negated partner-kit term that ticket 69 requires to stay: the product does not contact dealers for the Buyer.

reviewed.contains: otdog never contacts a dealer itself.
reviewed.justification: Negated positioning statement in the partner kit, matching the footer and DEVELOPMENT_SPEC.md section 1.3.
